Nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts have plenty to explore beyond the sand. The Bayshore Bikeway offers miles of scenic, protected cycling along the water, connecting Imperial Beach to neighboring Coronado and beyond. For those craving a truly unique coastal experience, Border Field State Park marks the southernmost beach in the continental United States.  Despite its small-town feel, Imperial Beach offers real convenience: it sits roughly fourteen miles south of downtown San Diego and just minutes from Coronado, putting the city's dining, culture, and employment centers well within reach while still coming home to a quieter, ocean-close setting each day.
